parameters.query:
UPDATE claims SET stuck_notified_at = now()
WHERE status IN ('pending_review', 'partially_reviewed')
  AND draft_generated_at < now() - interval '24 hours'
  AND (stuck_notified_at IS NULL OR stuck_notified_at < draft_generated_at)
RETURNING claim_id, doctor_id, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - draft_generated_at)) / 3600 AS age_hours

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO notifications (kind, severity, title, message, claim_id, ref_id)
  SELECT kind, severity, title, message, claim_id, ref_id
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(kind text, severity text, title text, message text, claim_id text, ref_id text)
  RETURNING id, kind, severity, title, message, claim_id, created_at
)
SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(ins)), '[]'::jsonb) AS rows FROM ins

WITH ins AS (
  INSERT INTO audit_events (ts, actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, patient_id, code, previous_value, new_value, run_id, version, metadata)
  SELECT COALESCE(ts::timestamptz, now()), actor, actor_type, event, entity, claim_id, visit_id, patient_id, code, previous_value, new_value, run_id, version, COALESCE(metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS x(ts text, actor text, actor_type text, event text, entity text, claim_id text, visit_id text, patient_id text, code text, previous_value text, new_value text, run_id text, version text, metadata jsonb)
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT count(*)::int AS written FROM ins
